Sonu @ Sunil Kumar Agrawal vs Through Food And Drug 
Administration By ... on 13 November, 2024 
Author: Roopesh Chandra Varshney
Bench: Roopesh Chandra Varshney
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Gwl:19861
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Roopesh Chandra Varshney
 On The 13th Of November, 2024
 Misc. Civil Case No. 2780 of 2024
 Sonu @ Sunil Kumar Agrawal
 Versus
 Through Food And Drug Administration By Shri Avnish
 Gupta Food Safety Officer And Drug Administratio
 Appearance:
 Shri V.P.S. Tomar- Advocate For The Applicant.
 Shri S.S. Kushwah- Government Advocate For
 Respondent/State.
 Order
This is an application for restoration of M.A.No.4857/2024, which stood dismissed for want of prosecution by order dated 20.07.2024. 
For the reasons assigned in the application, which is supported by an affidavit, sufficient cause is made out for restoration of M.A.No.4857/2024, hence, application is allowed and M.A.No.4857/2024 is restored to its original number. 
A copy of this order be placed in the record of M.A.No.4857/2024. This M.C.C. stands disposed of accordingly. 
(ROOPESH CHANDRA VARSHNEY) JUDGE shivani Sonu @ Sunil Kumar Agrawal vs Through Food And Drug Administration By ... on 13 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33096721/
